BiblicalUsage: limmûwd means instructed, and no one who reads the Bible can walk past it. In Isaiah 50:4, "he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned."; and in Isaiah 54:13, "And all thy children [shall be] taught of the LORD". In Isaiah 8:16, "seal the law among my disciples."; and in Jeremiah 13:23, "or the leopard his spots?".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the instructed are the ones God teaches Himself — the tongue of the learned that speaks a word in season, and the children taught of the Lord. I hold that the same word marks those accustomed to do evil: we become what we are taught. My position is that I want to be taught of the Lord, morning by morning, until His word is the first thing on my tongue.
